title: Dead Reckoning
description: Play a complete 3D chess match where fog reveals only squares your pieces attack while a greedy AI moves unseen.

prompt.objective: Build atmospheric 3D chess where each army sees only squares its pieces attack.

mintAssets.brief: Three themed chess sets, each with six sculpted piece roles and a matching rocky island.
Three wide sumi-e backdrops: misty mountains, teal underwater canyon, and windblown snow.

experience: Play chess against a greedy capture-first AI.
Recompute fog after every move as hidden pieces emerge.
Switch among mist, ocean, and snow themes mid-match.
prompt.visualDirection: Polished bone and black lacquer, rolling fog, cinnabar accents, and Japanese ink-wash scenery.

thumbnail.alt: Polished ivory and black chess pieces emerging from pale fog above a rocky board in an ink-wash mountain valley.

social.title: Dead Reckoning
social.description: Command a sculpted chess army through shifting fog against a capture-hungry unseen opponent.
